# idea-jpd-draft


Tomar una idea validated en drafts/, estructurarla como JPD draft y guardar en 10-Projects/{PROJECT}/jpd/draft/, archivando el original.



## Triggers

- enriquecer draft

- madurar idea

- estructurar idea

- draft enrich

- draft desde validated




## What I do

- Identify a validated draft from 00-Inbox/drafts/ and structure it as a JPD draft

- Guide the user through sections: idea, description, insights, value, risks, tasks

- Generate a JPD draft markdown file in 10-Projects/{PROJECT}/jpd/draft/

- Archive the original validated draft

- Promote the JPD draft to validated status when ready




## Usage examples

- Enriquecer un draft validated a formato JPD

- Estructurar una idea para Jira Product Discovery

- Tomar un draft investigado y convertirlo en JPD draft
